steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Paper 2 is worth 50% of the GCSE and lasts 1 hour 30 minutes

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: It focuses on Homer's Odyssey — you need detailed knowledge of the set books

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The paper tests literary analysis: character, theme, plot and Homer's techniques

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Character questions ask you to analyse Odysseus, Penelope, Telemachus and the suitors

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Q: What percentage is Paper 2 worth? | Q: What is the key difference between Paper 1 and Paper 2? | Q: How should you approach a character question?

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.body: 50% — equally weighted with Paper 1. | Paper 1 covers myth and religion thematically; Paper 2 focuses on literary analysis of the Odyssey. | Identify key qualities, support each with specific episodes, discuss significance to the poem's themes, and address complexities.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Always use specific episode references with book numbers Know key episodes in detail: Cyclops, Circe, Sirens, return to Ithaca, bow contest Character complexity is rewarded — discuss flaws as well as strengths Compare characters when relevant — Eumaeus vs suitors on xenia, Odysseus vs Achilles on heroism Homer's techniques (epic simile, foreshadowing) are often examined — know them with examples
